title: First Unique Letter
statement: Return the index of the first letter in a string that appears exactly once, or -1 if every letter repeats.

answerKey.pattern: Count letters in a map, then scan again for the first count of 1
keyPoints: Second pass: return the first index whose letter has count 1
edgeCases: The unique letter is the last one
acceptableSlowerApproaches: For each letter, count it again in the whole string: O(n^2)

hints: Counting each letter again for every position is O(n^2). Can you count all letters first?
One pass to fill a map of counts, a second pass to find the answer.
The second pass goes through the string in order, so the first match is the answer.
